message.content: {"action":"switch_architecture","reason":"The best evaluated point is coef_frac=15, rne, symmetric_preadd: it matches the highest SQNR (85.14 dB) while using substantially less area (8520 um^2) than the direct form (12782 um^2). Switching architecture has one legal unvisited neighbor and can explore the remaining structural variant, whereas decreasing precision or changing rounding has already shown large SQNR loss (e.g., frac=14 drops to ~78.7 dB) and increasing precision is unavailable. This balances numerical quality and mapped area best."}
